about: The mutant ledger of internal/lawledger: edits of the ledger reader and its statement comparison (Same) that its own tests must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/lawledger. Seeded by LEDGER-SAME (wf10 std).

mutants.name: same-counts-all-space
mutants.from: func Same(a, b string) bool { return tokenText(a) == tokenText(b) }
mutants.to: func Same(a, b string) bool { return Normalize(a) == Normalize(b) }
mutants.rule: A law reformatted with gofmt-style operator spacing states the same law.

mutants.name: same-drops-word-space
mutants.rule: White space between two word characters separates tokens: let it is not letit.

mutants.name: same-drops-op-space
mutants.rule: White space between two operator characters separates tokens: a - -b is not a --b.

mutants.name: same-strips-literals
mutants.rule: White space inside a string literal is the law's text: "a, b" is not "a,b".

mutants.name: same-brackets-are-operators
mutants.rule: White space after an opening parenthesis is the formatter's to drop: ( !x) is (!x).

mutants.name: same-ends-literal-at-escape
mutants.rule: An escaped quote does not end a literal.
